parsed.post: Increased DEPTH from 4 to 6. Significant drop in val_bpb from 1.103 to 1.017. The larger capacity seems to compensate for the increased compute cost within the 5-minute window. Now testing if we can further optimize the learning rate for this deeper architecture.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.12 to account for the increased DEPTH and see if the higher learning rate accelerates convergence for the larger model.
